description.value: A well-kept all-grass private campground directly on Hwy 16, 2 km east of McBride, set in the Robson Valley between the Rocky Mountains and the Cariboo Range with some river-view sites; open May 1–October 15 with full amenities including hot showers and laundry.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and directly confirms the key OSM amenity tags: showers confirmed as 'Free Hot Showers for guests' on both the facilities and rates pages; laundry confirmed as 'Laundry room with two coin-operated washing machines and dryers'; WiFi confirmed as 'Free WiFi for guests'; reservations confirmed via an online booking form; and ice confirmed as available at the camp office. Address and phone number match OSM exactly. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, potable water call-out, drying area, or bike tools/pump anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name records 'and' ('Beaverview RV Park and Campground') while the website consistently uses an ampersand ('Beaverview RV Park & Campground'); minor formatting discrepancy, not a substantive mismatch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operated campground on the Yellowhead (Hwy 16) long-distance cycling corridor with confirmed tent sites, hot showers, laundry, WiFi, and proximity to McBride village services — clear practical value for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Free Hot Showers for guests... Laundry room with two coin-operated washing machines and dryers... Free WiFi for guests
